theorems.label: thm:hard
theorems.excerpt: thm:hard OVERLOAD is NP-complete and SAFE is coNP-complete, even with unit bursts, equal fixed reservations, and arrivals restricted to four epochs. The phase-interaction graph of the construction is the input graph.

theorems.label: prop:cornergap
theorems.excerpt: prop:cornergap For one unit-rate queue and m unit bursts with windows [j,j+m] , every vector choosing only interval endpoints has peak one, while the exact robust peak is m .

theorems.label: prop:corrgap
theorems.excerpt: prop:corrgap There are schedules whose every burst has marginal window [j,j+m-1] and whose exact peak is one, while the independent rectangular relaxation requires m .

theorems.label: prop:privategap
theorems.excerpt: prop:privategap For n tenants, two instances can have the same vector of private maxima, all equal to one, while their exact shared pools are one and n .

theorems.label: prop:calendargap
